title: Parts Volume Discount on Repeat Repair Estimates — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders repeat repair estimate, the parts volume discount follows the account's customer-pay parts purchases:

| Account's customer-pay parts charges dated within the last twelve whole months | Further share taken off the indexed parts price, together with the tier's parts discount |
|---|---|
| 10000.00 or more | 0.05 |
| At least 5000.00 and less than 10000.00 | 0.03 |
| Less than 5000.00 | nothing more |

**Window.** A record falls within the last twelve whole months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its date from the day the estimate is priced, a whole month being complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day, so records dated on that day count. Every customer-pay parts charge on the account counts, as charged.

**Hypothetical.** Parts charges of 6240.00 in the window and a tier parts discount of 0.05: the indexed parts price is reduced by 0.08 of itself.
